name: Handicaps
overview: Scripture recognizes physical handicaps as part of God's sovereign design, as seen in Exodus 4:11 where the Lord declares His authority over all human conditions including blindness and deafness. The law in Leviticus 19:14 commands respect and care for those with such challenges, forbidding cursing the deaf or causing the blind to stumble. While Leviticus 21:17 restricts those with physical blemishes from priestly service, Isaiah 35:5 foretells a future restoration where the blind and deaf will be healed. The ministry of Jesus, highlighted in Matthew 11:4, demonstrates the fulfillment of this healing, confirming God's power to overcome physical limitations.
